name: How do you manage multiple trades on a tight site or busy schedule?

mainEntity.name: How do you manage multiple trades on a tight site or busy schedule?

acceptedAnswer.text: The project manager staggers trades, sequences tasks to minimize overlap, and coordinates deliveries and access, reducing conflicts, rework, and downtime on site.
